paths.title: AI for Consultants
paths.tagline: From client-document briefings to a repeatable, AI-assisted engagement workflow.
paths.description: A ladder of 6 hands-on lessons for consultants covering the AI workflows that make engagements faster without sacrificing rigor: synthesizing a stack of client documents into a sourced briefing, structuring findings into a defensible deliverable storyline, researching a client's industry before a proposal, writing conclusion-driven slide narratives and executive summaries, preparing sharper stakeholder interviews and workshops, and building a documented, repeatable engagement workflow with AI at each stage.

paths.title: AI for Project Managers
paths.tagline: From meeting notes that turn into action to a full PM operating system.
paths.description: A ladder of 6 hands-on lessons for project managers covering the AI workflows that save real time without sacrificing accountability: turning meeting notes into decisions, actions and owners, writing status reports stakeholders actually read, drafting project plans and work breakdowns from a goal, building risk registers with real mitigations, drafting stakeholder communications for difficult moments, and assembling your own PM operating system of templates and recurring workflows.
